_comment: Transport campaign, fourth stage: TARGETED, BUDGETED fibre relaxation. FROZEN 2026-09-02 by commit BEFORE any run. Licensed by docs/GATEWAY_FIBRE_RELAXATION.md (c = 0.5 recovers 96% of the oracle; all-walker relaxation costs 106x because mass moves in the basins where the mean force does not depend on the fibre). The relaxation LOCATION is chosen by an online, landscape-free sensitivity estimate and the AMOUNT by a compute budget; this is the experiment that decides whether transport deserves a WCA implementation.
_question: Can a fibre-relaxation policy that knows neither F nor omega's shape -- only the ABF force samples it already has -- concentrate the relaxation where the mean force is fibre-sensitive, retain most of the all-walker c = 0.5 benefit at a cost of order the outer dynamics, and make transport a better allocator than ABF at matched fibre treatment AFTER charging the relaxation?
inherits: the three parent preregs (cell, sampler, corrected baseline, alpha** = 0.00325, gamma 1.5, transport operator, OU propagator, endpoints, cluster bootstrap by seed, margins). Read-out: raw bins (the C1 intersection rule), 0.0175 reported.

sensitivity_estimator.rule: a second-moment accumulator Sf2(z) = sum f^2 is deposited with Sf and C at every step (bit-inert for every other arm); v_hat_t(z) = max(s(Sf2)/(s(C)+min_count) - (s(Sf)/(s(C)+min_count))^2, 0) with the ONLINE kernel h_bias = 0.07. No reference, no basin label, no omega.

relaxation_policy.importance: 'v': a_i = v_hat_t(x_i) for EVERY arm (the same fibre-relaxation policy for A, F, T: the fair matched-treatment comparison); 'v_dx': a_i = |dx_i| v_hat_t(x_i^+), transport arms only (the transport-optimised secondary arm T^move)
relaxation_policy.allocation: c_i = 1/2 [log(2 a_i / (lambda tau_i))]_+, tau_i = 1/omega(x_i)^2, lambda by bisection so that sum_i c_i tau_i = B per opportunity; B = rho x N x fr_every x dt, i.e. the notional constrained-MD cost is rho times the outer cost (fibre_cost_ratio = rho by construction whenever any a_i > 0)
relaxation_policy.then: per-walker exact OU propagation y <- e^{-c_i} y + sqrt((1 - e^{-2 c_i}) / (beta omega^2)) z, same placement and draw stream as the previous stages
relaxation_policy.diagnostics: budget fraction spent at |x| < 0.35 and OT displacement fraction there (REPORT-ONLY region labels, never used by the algorithm); active fraction; mean c over active walkers; tau_move

stage_D0_validation.metrics: at T (and t = 4, 10): Pearson correlation over [-1.5, 1.5] between the median online v_hat(x) and (a) the analytic Var(f|x), (b) the RESOLUTION-MATCHED reference s(v_ref C_T)/(s(C_T)+min_count) with the same kernel; relative L2 to (b); localisation = share of int v within |x| < 0.35 for v_hat vs (a)
stage_D0_validation.requirement: corr with (b) >= 0.90 at T. If it fails, fix the estimator (a separate amendment), not the policy; D1 does not start.

stage_D1_cost_ladder.arms: anchors A_0 (abf), F_0 (fr_uniform), T_0 (ot_exact); for each rho: A_rho, F_rho, T_rho (importance 'v'), Tmove_rho (importance 'v_dx'); references A_all0.5, T_all0.5 (all-walker c = 0.5, the closed campaign's 106x arm) -> 21 arms in ONE batch (batch_seed 91000)
stage_D1_cost_ladder.endpoints: per arm: I_F, e_F(T) (raw bins), b_flank, barrier error, frozen bias, fibre_cost_ratio, flank budget fraction, active fraction, mean c, tau_move and flank displacement fraction (OT arms). Retention ret_X(rho) = (I_F(X_0) - I_F(X_rho)) / (I_F(X_0) - I_F(X_all0.5)) for X in {A, T}. Contrasts (cluster bootstrap, 8 seeds, descriptive): T_rho vs A_rho, T_rho vs F_rho, Tmove_rho vs T_rho. Compute-to-accuracy C_X(eps) = tau_X(eps) x (1 + rho_X) on the median e_F(t) curve for eps in {e0/2, e0/4, e0/8, e_F^ABF(T)}, relative to C_{A_0}(eps).
stage_D1_cost_ladder.rho_star_rule: the SMALLEST rho <= 1 with (i) median Delta I_F(T_rho vs A_rho) <= -10% AND (ii) C_{T_rho}(e_F^ABF(T)) <= 0.8 C_{A_0}(e_F^ABF(T)). If none qualifies, rho* = 1 and gate_D1 = False (D2 still runs, for the record).

stage_D2_confirmatory.arms: A_0, F_0, T_0, A_rho*, F_rho*, T_rho*, Tmove_rho* -> 7 arms in ONE batch per chunk of 32 rows (batch_seed 101000 + offset)
stage_D2_confirmatory.primary: T_rho* vs A_rho* (Delta I_F, raw bins, cluster bootstrap by seed, 10000 resamples, seed 20260905). SCIENTIFIC SUCCESS = median <= -10% AND CI95 upper < 0 (verdict rule as before for SAFE / reversal).
stage_D2_confirmatory.deployability: C_{T_rho*}(e_F^ABF(T)) < 0.8 x C_{A_0}(e_F^ABF(T)) on the median curves (also reported at e0/8, e0/4, e0/2), with rho* <= 1
stage_D2_confirmatory.secondary: T_rho* vs F_rho* (decision rule OT_better / FR_better / equivalent / INCONCLUSIVE; NOT a gate); Tmove_rho* vs T_rho*; F_rho* vs A_rho*; A_rho* vs A_0; every arm vs A_0; frozen bias; F_0 vs A_0 must replicate
stage_D2_confirmatory.WCA_gate: scientific success AND deployability -> the molecular experiment (dimer transport along the bond + online-targeted constrained solvent relaxation, cost charged in full) is licensed

outcomes_frozen.GATE_MET: D2 scientific success AND deployability at rho* <= 1 -> WCA licensed
outcomes_frozen.SCIENCE_ONLY: scientific success but deployability fails (the relaxation is too expensive even targeted) -> transport adds value but not at this cost; redesign the budget
outcomes_frozen.NO_VALUE: primary not an accelerator at rho* -> targeted relaxation does not rescue transport at deployable cost; FR (which never pays it) stays the method
outcomes_frozen.mechanism_check: orthogonal: the budget fraction spent at |x| < 0.35 must exceed 0.8 at every rho while the OT displacement fraction there is below 0.3 -- the policy separates 'where mass moves' from 'where conditional equilibration matters' without being told either

prediction_recorded_now: D0 passes (corr >= 0.95 resolution-matched; peak at |x| ~ 0.15-0.25). D1: retention ret_T(rho) >= 0.5 at rho = 0.25 and >= 0.8 at rho = 1 (ChatGPT's 70-90% at rho = 1 is inside); budget fraction on the flank > 0.8 at every rho, displacement fraction there < 0.3; rho* = 0.5 (0.25 possible); T_rho vs A_rho -25 to -35% for rho >= 0.5; C_T(e_F^ABF(T))/C_{A_0} ~ 0.1-0.2, so the gate is met easily on the compute axis; Tmove vs T within +-5%; T vs F close/inconclusive (not required). D2: GATE_MET.
compute: D0 ~30 s; D1 one batch of 16 x 21 = 336 rows (~5 min incl. the per-opportunity bisection) + frozen bias; D2 two chunks of 224 rows (~4 min each) + frozen bias. GPU 3 ONLY.
prohibited: everything prohibited by the parent preregs; changing alpha**, gamma, h_bias, the OU propagator, or the read-out (raw bins)

any region label in the ALGORITHM (the |x| < 0.35 label is a diagnostic only); any use of omega' or F_ref in the policy (tau_i = 1/omega^2 is the exact-propagator's model knowledge, shared with the previous stage, and is stated as such)
choosing rho* by anything but the frozen rule; printing, storing or reading any D2 error metric before the committed analyzer runs on the complete block
adding or dropping arms after this file is committed; editing this file after D0 starts
